scanNote:
PHOTO FILE - UNIT 9 (raqamsiz bet, pdf 154). Qirqib olinadigan karta. Yuqorida to'q sariq 'UNIT 9'.

IKKI SURAT va QAYDLAR:
1-SURAT: Piza qiya minorasi va sobor (oq marmar, ko'k osmon). YaShIL QOG'OZ: Name: Leaning Tower of Pisa, Italy. Designer: Bonnano Pisano. Completed: 14th Century. Material: white marble. Built as: belltower of Pisa Cathedral. O'ngda 15 ta bo'sh qator.
2-SURAT: Parijdagi Zafar darvozasi (Arc de Triomphe), oldida mashinalar va daraxtlar. SARIQ QOG'OZ: Name: Arc de Triomphe, Paris, France. Designer: Jean-François-Thérèse Chalgrin. Date: 1835. Material: stone blocks. Built as: memorial to Napoleon's victorious battles. Chapda 15 ta bo'sh qator.

⚠ Bu 9-unitdagi Writing (mashhur inshootlar tavsifi, majhul nisbat) uchun shablon.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the notes about the two landmarks. Leaning Tower of Pisa, Italy - Designer: Bonnano Pisano; Completed: 14th Century; Material: white marble; Built as: belltower of Pisa Cathedral. Arc de Triomphe, Paris, France - Designer: Jean-François-Thérèse Chalgrin; Date: 1835; Material: stone blocks; Built as: memorial to Napoleon's victorious battles.
exercises.instructionUz: Ikki inshoot haqidagi qaydlarni o'qing. Piza qiya minorasi, Italiya - Dizayner: Bonnano Pisano; Tugallangan: 14-asr; Material: oq marmar; Qurilgan: Piza sobori qo'ng'iroq minorasi sifatida. Zafar darvozasi, Parij, Fransiya - Dizayner: Jean-François-Thérèse Chalgrin; Sana: 1835; Material: tosh bloklar; Qurilgan: Napoleon g'alabali janglari yodgorligi sifatida.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI INShOOT:

  PIZA QIYa MINORASI (Italiya):
    dizayner - Bonnano Pisano
    tugallangan - 14-asr
    material - oq marmar
    maqsad - Piza sobori qo'ng'iroq
      minorasi

  ZAFAR DARVOZASI (Parij):
    dizayner - Jean-François-
      Thérèse Chalgrin
    sana - 1835
    material - tosh bloklar
    maqsad - Napoleon g'alabali
      janglari yodgorligi


⚠ 'LEANING':

  = qiya, egilgan.
  ⚠ 'to lean' = egilmoq.


⚠ 'A BELLTOWER':

  = qo'ng'iroq minorasi.


⚠ 'A CATHEDRAL':

  = sobor (katta cherkov).


⚠ 'MARBLE':

  = marmar.


⚠ 'ARC DE TRIOMPHE':

  = Zafar darvozasi (fransuzcha).


⚠ 'A MEMORIAL':

  = yodgorlik.


⚠ 'VICTORIOUS':

  = g'alabali.
  ⚠ 'victory' = g'alaba.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the notes to write short descriptions of the two landmarks (Unit 9, Writing). Use the passive: was designed by, was completed in, is made of, was built as.
exercises.instructionUz: Qaydlardan foydalanib ikki inshootning qisqa tavsifini yozing (9-unit, Yozuv). Majhul nisbatni ishlating: was designed by, was completed in, is made of, was built as.
exercises.explanationUz:
INShOOT TAVSIFI - MAJHUL NISBAT
(9-unit):

  X is located in [joy].
  It WAS DESIGNED BY [kim].
  It WAS COMPLETED IN [qachon].
  It IS MADE OF [material].
  It WAS BUILT AS [maqsad].
  Today it IS VISITED BY ...

  ⚠ 'was designed BY' - bajaruvchi
  muhim (dizayner nomi).
  ⚠ 'is made of' - hozirgi zamon
  (hali ham shu materialdan).

structure.modelEn: The Leaning Tower of Pisa is one of the most famous landmarks in Italy. It was designed by Bonnano Pisano and it was completed in the 14th century. It is made of white marble. It was built as the belltower of Pisa Cathedral. Today it is visited by millions of tourists every year, who come to see the tower that leans to one side.
structure.modelUz: Piza qiya minorasi - Italiyadagi eng mashhur inshootlardan biri. U Bonnano Pisano tomonidan loyihalangan va 14-asrda tugallangan. U oq marmardan qurilgan. U Piza sobori qo'ng'iroq minorasi sifatida qurilgan. Bugun uni har yili millionlab sayyohlar ziyorat qiladi - ular bir tomonga egilgan minorani ko'rgani keladi.
structure.noteUz: Majhul: was designed, was completed, is made, was built.

structure.modelEn: The Arc de Triomphe is located in the heart of Paris, France. It was designed by Jean-François-Thérèse Chalgrin and it was completed in 1835. It is made of stone blocks. It was built as a memorial to Napoleon's victorious battles. Today it is one of the most popular tourist attractions in Paris.
structure.modelUz: Zafar darvozasi Fransiyaning Parij shahri markazida joylashgan. U Jean-François-Thérèse Chalgrin tomonidan loyihalangan va 1835 yilda tugallangan. U tosh bloklardan qurilgan. U Napoleon g'alabali janglari yodgorligi sifatida qurilgan. Bugun u Parijdagi eng mashhur sayyohlik joylaridan biri.
